courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
related.transfer: 可遷移「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「防線接續高程」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rotating-gate drive torque" and "Continuous defence elevations" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Maeslant storm-surge barrier must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適；荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘則以浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation; Maeslant storm-surge barrier centres on joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「浮運吃水與壓載」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「止水縫漏流診斷」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rotating-gate drive torque” and “Floating draft and ballast”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Maeslant storm-surge barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Seal leakage diagnosis", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「防線接續高程」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rotating-gate drive torque" and "Continuous defence elevations" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Venice MOSE flood barriers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適；威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統則以浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation; Venice MOSE flood barriers centres on coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「浮力翻轉與重心」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「關閉潟湖降雨收支」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rotating-gate drive torque” and “Buoyant rotation and centroids”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Venice MOSE flood barriers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 泰晤士河防洪閘
history.text: 泰晤士河防洪閘以橫跨河道的活動閘門保護倫敦，與上游河流、兩岸防線及河口潮汐共同作用。泰晤士河防洪閘開始建設，進入河口大型活動結構施工階段。 泰晤士河防洪閘開始具備實際運轉防洪功能。 五月八日正式啟用典禮，與開始運轉年份有所區別。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Thames Barrier protects London through movable gates across the river, interacting with upstream flow, bank defences and estuarine tides. Construction of the Thames Barrier begins, establishing the movable estuary structure. The Thames Barrier becomes operational for practical flood protection. Formal opening takes place on May eight, distinct from the operational starting year. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.textEn: Construction of the Thames Barrier begins, establishing the movable estuary structure.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「旋轉門體驅動力矩」到「海平面情境與調適」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Rotating-gate drive torque" through "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
